content.short: Bluefin is a high-performance DEX on Sui specializing in professional-grade perpetual trading and self-custody.
content.description:
Bluefin is a decentralized exchange on the Sui blockchain that focuses on providing a professional, high-performance trading experience for perpetual futures. It utilizes a hybrid orderbook model that combines an off-chain matching engine for centralized exchange-like speeds with on-chain settlement for full transparency and self-custody. This architecture allows Bluefin to offer sub-second trade finality and deep liquidity, making it an ideal platform for high-frequency traders and institutional participants seeking a decentralized alternative.

The platform emphasizes ease of use with Web2-like onboarding through zkLogin, enabling users to trade using their Google or Apple accounts without the need for complex seed phrases. Bluefin also features "gasless" trading, where network fees are often covered by the protocol to provide a seamless user experience. With its commitment to high speed, low fees, and advanced trading tools like cross-margin and sub-accounts, Bluefin is positioning itself as a premier destination for decentralized derivatives on the Sui network.
